notes: No source found that reports the lead's finding: buyer systems whose own records are clean while their only sellers hold chemical-limit violations (19 systems, 4,347 people; 8.4% vs 0.3%). Only pattern coverage on consecutive systems (EPA working group, ES&T paper). Saline Valley Conservancy District's arsenic MCL violation shows in the Illinois state record; no news story found on it, and no source found naming 'Millstone' with Saline Valley. The Southern Illinoisan (Harrisburg vs Saline Valley water dispute) and EWG's Saline Valley page were surfaced but blocked (HTTP 429 / 403), so not recorded. Oklahoma Watch 2022 on Moore, OK (buys from Oklahoma City, own-well arsenic violations) was surfaced but is not the same pattern, so not recorded. No coverage dated after 2026-06-30 found on this pattern; NYS Focus 2026-09-08 on NY systems with elevated toxins surfaced but not about buyer/seller systems. No source found that disagrees.
